rules.statement: V completed Regina's Monster Hunt gig by handing Jotaro Shobo over alive to her transport; Regina passed him on to the Moxes.
V took Jotaro Shobo down instead of delivering him alive, and Regina closed Monster Hunt as a kill, treating him as dead.
V incapacitated Blake and put him in Regina's transport alive; Regina's debrief confirmed the target was bagged and closed Shark in the Water.
V took Blake down instead of delivering him alive, and Regina closed Shark in the Water as a kill: the problem was gone and her client was happy.
V knocked Jae-Hyun out and delivered him alive in the trunk of Regina's car; Regina's debrief closed Small Man, Big Evil on that basis.
V took Jae-Hyun down instead of delivering him alive, and Regina closed Small Man, Big Evil treating him as dead.
V incapacitated Taki Kenmochi and delivered her alive to Regina's transport; Regina remarked on the rat V brought her and closed Troublesome Neighbors.
V took Taki Kenmochi down instead of delivering her alive, and Regina closed Troublesome Neighbors as one less Tyger in town.
V delivered the stolen Revere Courier syn-leather van to Regina's drop location, completing Many Ways to Skin a Cat.
V recovered Jacob Lamb's optical implant and deposited it in Regina's drop point, completing Playing for Keeps.
V stole the recording of the Maelstrom initiation surgery and Regina received the data, closing Rite of Passage.
V recovered the raw XBD of Bryce Stone's son's murder and deposited it in Regina's drop point, completing Dirty Biz.
V recovered the stolen medicine and deposited it in Regina's drop point, completing Backs Against the Wall.
V uploaded b@d's malware into the Megabuilding H11 server for Regina, completing Catch a Tyger's Toe.
V found Alois Daquin's laptop and deposited it in Regina's drop point; Regina said it was exactly the tech she wanted.
V stole the Malorian van's databank from the Maelstrom warehouse and deposited it in Regina's drop point, completing Lousy Kleppers.
V got Hwangbo out of the motel and escorted him to his nomad contacts alive, completing Flight of the Cheetah for Regina.
V planted Regina's GPS tracker on Mikhail Akulov's car at the Kabuki docks, completing Welcome to America, Comrade.
V planted the tracker on Akulov's car without being detected; Regina praised the job as silent and effective and added a bonus.
V planted the tracker on Akulov's car but drew attention at the docks; Regina complained it was supposed to be hush-hush, though the bug was planted.
V stole Mikhail Akulov's datashard from Hotel Raito and delivered it to Regina's client, completing Fixer, Merc, Soldier, Spy.
V got Akulov's shard out of Hotel Raito without raising the alarm; Regina called it quiet as a roach and was impressed.
V raised the alarm at Hotel Raito while getting Akulov's shard; Regina said it could have been done quietly and half the city would hear about the mess.
V freed Roh from the Tyger Claws dojo and got him to Regina's transport alive; Regina confirmed Roh was secured and closed Bloodsport.
V got Roh out of the Tyger Claws dojo without raising the alarm; Regina said she was impressed by how professionally it was handled.
V raised the alarm while rescuing Roh from the Tyger Claws dojo; Regina said she had expected more discretion.
V talked Anna Hamill into dropping her police investigation without a fight, and Regina closed Woman of La Mancha as a success.
Aaron McCarlson turned hostile and V killed him; Regina said it could have been handled differently, and with the client dead there was no payment.
Aaron McCarlson turned hostile and V left him unconscious rather than dead; Regina said that once he woke, the recording would give them an inside source at the NCPD.
After V finished her Watson gigs, Regina messaged that she had no more contracts, urged V to take a break from the city, and left a farewell gift in V's stash.
V brought the talking smart pistol Skippy to Regina Jones, its owner, and handed him over.
When V returned Skippy, he was locked in pacifist mode; Regina reset him to factory settings and gave the pistol a new name.
After Skippy's creator bought back the AI component, Regina offered V the smart pistol without the AI.
